Basic network connectivity looks normal within the scope of this run.
The DNS response explicitly reports that the queried name does not exist. This does not imply that the DNS service as a whole has failed.
Public connectivity has positive evidence, but the DNS query did not complete normally. The cause may involve DNS service, Private DNS, VPN or network configuration.
The DNS response explicitly reports that the target name does not exist. This is not a conclusion of a global DNS failure.
Public connectivity has positive evidence, but the target DNS query did not complete normally. The cause may involve the DNS path or target name configuration.
DNS query did not complete normally
DNS service or the current DNS path
Private DNS, VPN or proxy configuration
Target port did not accept the connection
The target port refused the connection, providing an explicit response from the target-side IP path. This is not equivalent to a routing or Internet failure.
Public connectivity has positive evidence, but the target reported no route or network unreachable. The issue may involve the target address family or path.
The target reported no route or network unreachable. Public connectivity evidence is insufficient to attribute this to the target service.
Target address family or access path
Target connection did not respond in time
Public connectivity has positive evidence, but the target service or access path did not respond in time. This does not establish that the website or service is down.
The target did not respond in time, and public connectivity evidence is insufficient to distinguish a service issue from a network path issue.
The network may require system sign-in. This is not a conclusion of router or DNS service failure.
An address in the special-purpose 198.18.0.0/15 range was observed. A Fake-IP DNS environment may be present; this is not equivalent to a DNS error.
The VPN connection path appeared normal or was recorded separately in this run. Results may reflect the network environment beyond the VPN tunnel.
Basic connectivity looks normal within the scope of this run. This does not guarantee that every app or website works.
The device has no available active network connection. Check Wi-Fi or mobile data first.
Network sign-in may be required, and some public network access may be restricted.

Comparing networks can help distinguish local environment issues from target path issues.
